tagline: Explore Hello Kitty Island Adventure's real islands, items and music — read straight from your own install.
description: HKIA Island Explorer is an .exe mod for Hello Kitty Island Adventure. It reads real HKIA content — island regions, items, and music tracks — straight from your own installed copy of Hello Kitty Island Adventure while it runs, and lets you browse them. Nothing is ever copied out of or modified in your HKIA install. Single player.
whatPlayerDoes: Launch the explorer .exe; it reads HKIA's real entity scenes and music banks from your install and shows the islands, items, and tracks found there.
firstMinute: The exe opens, scans your HKIA install folder, lists island regions (Merry Meadows, Gemstone Mountain, Icy Peak, Rainbow Reef, Cloud Island, Heart of the Island and more), items (strawberry, cactus cream, almond, chocolate coin, heart pie...), and music tracks (MX_Score_MerryMeadows.bank, etc.) — all from your own HKIA files.
build: C# source (source/hkia-island-explorer.cs) compiled to build/hkia-island-explorer.exe with csc.exe (.NET Framework 4.0). Launched by Melty with -gamepath {game:custom-hello-kitty-island-adventure}.
